//: The creditor list every per-court matrix golden beside this file is
rendered from (ADR 0024, build PR 2). Creditor records in the API's own
request-body shape — the shape seeds/fixtures/<version>/cases.json uses —
so a fixture version whose creditors carry full addresses can take this
list as it is. The seeded case (seeds/fixtures/v2, chapter-7-sample)
cannot yield a matrix today: its two creditors have no city, state or ZIP,
and the generator refuses them, as it should.
Chosen to exercise what the courts differ on and what they share: out of
alphabetical order on purpose, one creditor recorded twice (two accounts,
one mailing label: printed once), a second address line, a nine-digit ZIP,
and every line within the common 40 characters so each court's file is
produced. `case_number` is what the court would have issued; it prints
only on E.D. Tex.'s separately-filed matrix (txeb_filed_separately.txt).
Every name and address is invented and describes nobody.
